reason: Two independent failures share one shape: a repository-local path with more than one owner, or with an owner that only reads it. The Learning-root split-brain let close gate on one location while projection re-derived another, and the agent-map PHPStan cache lands outside the state root that docs/compact-layout.md described as a complete mapping. Scope covers the layout owner, the dispatcher that injects owned paths, and the migration document, because the rule is only checkable where paths are spelled.
remaining_uncertainty: Redirecting agent-map's PHPStan result cache needs a cache-location option in agent-map; no failing case has been produced yet.
new: A repository-local derived path has one owner for reading and writing. Where an upstream package hardcodes a path we cannot redirect, name the exception in docs/compact-layout.md rather than letting the mapping claim completeness.
boundary: Applies to repository-local workflow and derived state. It does not apply to source, vendor, or paths a focused package CLI is explicitly asked to use.

validation_case.given: a repository-local derived path such as the map search index or a PHPStan cache
validation_case.when: one component resolves it from ProjectLayout and another re-derives or hardcodes it
validation_case.then: the two answers agree only in the default configuration and the disagreement surfaces as missing evidence rather than as an error
